item.title: Father Adam Sztark: The Polish Jesuit who died saving Jewish children
item.description: A Polish Jesuit used disguises and cunning to save Jews from the Holocaust, refusing three chances to escape his own execution to remain with those he served.

item.title: Canadian Catholic bishops join members of Parliament in push to restrict medical aid in dying
item.description: The Canadian bishops issued a statement Feb. 5 supporting Bill C-218, which would prevent persons whose sole medical condition is mental illness from accessing physician-assisted suicide.

item.title: Zambia bishops instruct clergy and faithful to stay out of partisan politics
item.description: “The Church is not and must never be a mouthpiece for any political party or candidate,” the Zambian bishops stated. Read more in this roundup of world news that you may have missed this past week.

item.title: Cuba’s bishops headed to Vatican this month to meet with Pope Leo XIV
item.description: The country’s bishops will travel to Rome from Feb. 16–20 to present to Pope Leo XIV “the vicissitudes, sorrows, joys, and hopes of the Church in Cuba.”

item.title: The story of the 4-year-old whose faith led to lowering the age of first Communion
item.description: “Little Nellie” was a 4-year-old child from Cork, Ireland, whose piety and closeness to God led in part to the lowering of the age at which children could receive their first holy Communion.

item.title: University student from England being considered for canonization
item.description: Vatican representatives are in the process of reviewing the life of Pedro Ballester, a British university student who died of cancer in 2018, to gauge whether his canonization cause should be opened.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV will not travel to the United States in 2026, Vatican says
item.description: The pontiff is expected to travel to Africa in April, visit Peru later this year, and make a summer stop in Spain.

item.title: Catholic activist Jimmy Lai sentenced to 20 years in prison in Hong Kong national security trial
item.description: The human rights advocate has been convicted and sentenced multiple times since 2020.
